duration.text: The History of Ancient China at Chongqing Normal University is a 0 N/A long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 2361 USD/In total ￥ 17000 CNY/In total

materials.text: 1.Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number&expiration date and name included. 2.Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. 3.Graduation certificate of high school Graduation certificate should be in Chinese or English. If not, it should be translated into Chinese or English and be notarized. 4.Academic transcript of high school 5.Two Recommendation letters From Professors, associate professors or equivalents.

requirements.text: Applicants should have a bachelor degree or above with new HSK Band 4 certificate. For those who haven't HSK certificate but with equivalent Chinese proficiency by School evaluation, you could apply to enter study in programs but must achieve the HSK certificate in one year.
